Note for the spec: because BAFU already contains 'Naphtha, at refinery' [RER] as a unit process of the same product, this dataset is reachable by strategy S2 (template transfer) even though no report prints its inventory; that is a different claim from 'the report documents it', which is what this step asks, hence found = false.
